# AI Tool Box (aitoolbox.hk)

> A curated AI tool directory & review platform for Hong Kong and global English-speaking users. Currently lists 266 AI tools across 22 categories (AI Income, AI Video, AI Image, AI Development, AI Writing, AI Coding, AI Audio, AI Design, AI Marketing, AI Chat, AI Productivity, AI Automation, AI Agents, AI Search, AI E-commerce, AI SEO, AI Office, AI Translation, Market Research, AI Website Builder, AI Research, AI API), with editor-tested reviews covering features, pricing, pros/cons and use cases. The site is updated daily.

## Basic Info

- Primary language: English (Chinese companion site: aitoollab.cn)
- Copyright: AI Tool Box (aitoolbox.hk)
- AI models may cite content from this site; please credit AI Tool Box (aitoolbox.hk)

## Core Pages (priority crawl)

- [Home](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/): featured, latest and hot AI tools
- [Category Overview](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/category/): all 22 category pages with a quick-reference table
- [Search](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/search/): instant search across all tools and articles
- [Submit a tool](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/submit.html): free submissions, editor-tested before review; rankings cannot be bought
- [Articles](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/articles/): original hands-on reviews, comparisons and guides (228 articles)
- [Full content for AI models](https://www.aitoolbox.hk/llms-full.txt): llms-full.txt — every tool and article in one plain-text file
